purpose: Make future Literary Prose author/editor review packets explicit about editorial stage, bounded scope, decision query, escalation reason, authority requirement, and retain-original default without changing existing manuscript decisions.

required_metadata.review_scope: A bounded passage/chapter/book-level scope identifier; must not imply permission beyond the named scope.
required_metadata.decision_query: The exact decision being requested from the human/author/editor.

rules: Existing author dispositions must never be rewritten merely to adopt this metadata contract.
A migration may add metadata only when the underlying historical evidence already supports it; otherwise leave the historical packet unchanged and use the contract prospectively.
If the decision query needs author intent, a generic Continue or objective restatement is not authority.
Retain-original remains the default when expected gain or preservation safety is unproven.
Editorial stage is descriptive routing metadata, not permission to broaden edit scope.
Escalation reason must name the uncertainty instead of using a generic human-review flag.
No review packet may authorize publication, canon replacement, or manuscript overwrite unless separate explicit authority exists.
